item.title: Takachiho Shrine — Guide
item.description: Takachiho Shrine (Takachiho Jinja), founded some 1,900 years ago, is the spiritual heart of the mythologically rich town of Takachiho in northern Miyazaki. Set in a serene, atmospheric grove of towering ancient cedar trees, the weathered wooden shrine radiates a deep sense of age and sanctity. Among its treasures is a magnificent pair of 800-year-old ‘meoto sugi’ (husband-and-wife cedar trees), joined at the roots, around which couples walk hand in hand for blessings of love, marriage and harmony.
